attributionLimits: Module renderedBytes are before final chunk minification, not additive compressed transfer costs.
Styles list observed CSS module source bytes; nested imports may be internal to Vite. These are not additive emitted CSS costs.
Reachability is the conservative static reference graph, not measured browser downloads or timing.
All active aggregate ceilings/findings remain unchanged; this is not a new performance policy.
scope: All emitted paths and selected text formats; hashes and level-9 gzip sizes for every regular file. HTML asset attributes, CSS url(), JS quoted static asset paths, and manifest icons/start_url are resolved locally. No network requests.
limits: Targeted common credential signatures and private-source path checks, not a comprehensive secret or binary metadata audit.
Computed URLs and browser/deployed-host behavior require journey checks; this scanner does not execute application code.
Size ceilings are provisional local review regression limits, not maintainer-agreed performance budgets or measured user experience.
External resource references are inventoried by protocol only, not fetched or qualified.

gzip.meaning: Sum of separately compressed file bytes; not a server compression or network timing measurement.

documentCosts.scope: Each HTML document plus de-duplicated local files reachable through the scanner's static reference graph. Other HTML navigation targets are excluded, including manifest start_url.
limits: Diagnostic only: these measurements do not replace aggregate budgets, findings or the qualification result.
Quoted JavaScript assets and dynamic imports, manifest icons, and CSS references are included conservatively; they may not be requested on this route.
Computed URLs and external resources are not measured; unresolved local references remain qualification findings.
Not an initial-download, cache, compression, network timing or browser-performance measurement.
